title: A change that can break a workflow or someone's access
paragraphs: This change can stop a program, a person or another computer from doing something that works today, for example connecting to a share, signing in with an older method or using a removable drive.
Check who and what uses the computer before you agree, and choose a time when a problem can be dealt with. EasyRMM never restarts the computer; if this change needs a restart, the item says so.
The setting is read again after the change. If it is not as intended, EasyRMM puts the old value back and marks the item as failed.
undoNote: Undo puts back the value the computer had before.
